help.title: Meal Snap – Help
help.intro: Meal Snap breaks a photo of a meal down into individual foods with an estimated weight and calories, so you can log them in your calorie tracker one by one. It runs in your browser, is free, and needs no registration with us.
help.keyTitle: 1. Get a free AI key (Google Gemini)
help.keySteps:
1. Open aistudio.google.com/app/apikey and sign in with a Google account.
  2. Accept the terms if asked, then tap Create API key.
  3. Copy the key. It starts with AIza.
  4. In Meal Snap, go to Settings, choose Google Gemini, paste the key and tap Test key.

The free tier is enough for normal personal use. You don't need to enter a card.
help.installTitle: 2. Add the app to your home screen
help.installSteps:
iPhone / iPad (Safari):

  1. Open this page in Safari.
  2. Tap the Share button (square with an arrow).
  3. Choose Add to Home Screen and confirm.

Android (Chrome): menu ⋮ → Install app or Add to Home screen.
help.useSteps:
1. Tap the photo area and take a picture from above, with the whole plate in frame.
  2. Optionally add a note: portion size, how it was cooked, what is inside. You can type or dictate it.
  3. Tap Analyze meal. If the AI cannot tell something important from the photo, such as whether the meat is chicken or duck, it asks first. Tap an answer, or write it in the note.
  4. Check the grams and correct them if needed. Calories update automatically. The pencil icon edits the values per 100 g.
  5. Tap the copy icon next to a food to copy its name, then paste it into the search box of your calorie app. Copy all copies the whole list with grams.
help.voiceText: The microphone button next to the note records your voice, and the AI provider you picked (Gemini or OpenAI) turns it into text. Tap the microphone again to stop recording. Claude can't transcribe audio, so with Claude the app tries the browser's own dictation. If that doesn't work, use the microphone key on your keyboard, which works everywhere.
help.paidText: You can also use Anthropic Claude (get a key) or OpenAI (get a key). You need to add credit with the provider first. With the default models, one photo usually costs well under one cent.
help.privacyText:
• Your API key and history are stored only in this browser on this device.
  • Photos and notes go directly from your phone to the AI provider you picked. The author of this app never sees them.
  • Your Kalorické tabulky login goes through a proxy. The default proxy is run by the author of this app: it doesn't store or log your login, it only passes it on to Kalorické tabulky. If you'd rather not trust the author, deploy your own proxy (steps above).
  • The password isn't stored, only its MD5 hash. That hash still signs you in just like the password, so don't lend the device to strangers.
  • On Gemini's free tier, Google may use the data to improve its services. Don't photograph anything private.
help.ktText:
Below the breakdown there is a Log to Kalorické tabulky button. The date and the meal (breakfast to second dinner) are preselected from when the photo was taken, and you can change both.

For each item the app looks up a matching food in the Kalorické tabulky database (the KT row) and preselects the best match. Whole dishes (e.g. a chicken leg with rice) are skipped, because the other parts of the plate are separate items. The list also shows calories per 100 g, so you can tell whether it fits. A database food is logged with your weight, and Kalorické tabulky then has its exact nutrition data, including fibre, sugar and salt. If none of the offered foods fits, choose Own food and the values from the analysis are logged instead. Renaming an item searches again.

Setup: in Settings → Kalorické tabulky, enter the e-mail and password you use for Kalorické tabulky and tap Check login. That's all.

Kalorické tabulky has no public API and can't be called from the browser, so the app goes through a small go-between (a proxy). The default proxy is run by the author of this app. For each export it signs in, writes the items and forgets everything.

Your own proxy (optional). If you'd rather not send your login through someone else's proxy, deploy your own for free on Cloudflare:

  1. Create an account at dash.cloudflare.com.
  2. Choose Workers & Pages → Create → Create Worker, name it (e.g. meal-snap-kt) and tap Deploy.
  3. Tap Edit code, replace all the code with the contents of worker/kt-proxy.js and tap Deploy again.
  4. In Settings → Variables and Secrets, add a variable ALLOWED_ORIGINS set to the address Meal Snap runs at, without a trailing slash (e.g. https://name.github.io).
  5. Paste the worker's address (https://meal-snap-kt.<account>.workers.dev) into the Proxy URL field under Settings → Kalorické tabulky.

Logging uses the site's unofficial interface, so it can stop working when Kalorické tabulky changes its website.
help.accuracyText: These are estimates from a photo. Weights in particular can be off by tens of percent. When it matters, weigh the food and correct the grams.
